messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: HIGH - GPU pool autoscale failed (policy: realtime-autoscale) — queue growth > 3000, throttle rate > 85% — Paging on-call

alice_oncall: I'm on it. seeing large pending queue on gpu-realtime-rt1, autoscaler logs show `scale_limit_reached` across region-us-west1

alice_oncall: PromQL I ran: `sum(rate(requests_pending_total[1m])) by (pool)` -> gpu-realtime-rt1 spike ~3200

ben_runtime: confirmed. Worker nodes show ~28% stranded GPU memory on several nodes due to MIG fragmentation. Some nodes report 2x small-mig free but can't host 1 large instance.

carla_mlinfra: which MIG configs are involved? last deploy changed default MIG size to `1g.1gb` for some models, but production models want `7g.40gb`/`3g.20gb` profiles.

ben_runtime: exact problem: binpack algorithm expects homogeneous MIGs, but we have mixed profiles (1g,3g,7g) — scheduler refuses to place large requests on nodes with many small slices even if aggregate free. results in stranded capacity.

alice_oncall: autoscaler hitting hard limit: `GlobalGPUQuotaLimit=120` (we're at 118 GPUs active), policy allowed > but can't spin new because region quota per-customer is capped.

devon_support: I'm seeing customer-reported errors: "model served at capacity, try again later" from 3 enterprise customers. CS pinged me for ETA.

alice_oncall: short-term mitigation plan: 1) throttle non-critical batch jobs 2) fallback route some requests to smaller model variant 3) manual rebalance / drain nodes with fragmented MIGs to consolidate free slices 4) request temporary quota bump if needed.

morgan_prodeng: Can we failover traffic to dedicated pool (redwood-dedicated-urgent)? That's reserved but has headroom 6 GPUs. Might help for highest priority tenants.

alice_oncall: yes, can we divert top-5 customers to dedicated pool as emergency? Need DevOps approval and routing change.

ben_runtime: meanwhile I'm going to identify nodes with ~>60% free GPU memory but unusable for large MIGs. will prepare `kubectl drain` plan.

carla_mlinfra: also we should temporarily relax placement constraints: allow cross-MIG packing with `allow_fragment_coalesce=true` on scheduler to permit filling free slices into larger allocations (risky).

alice_oncall: don't change scheduler flags without rollback plan. Do manual first.

sre_shift_lead: I approve manual rebalancing + divert top 5 customers. I'll own communications with infra team for quota request.

pagerduty: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled in 25m to morgan_prodeng. If unresolved by handoff, escalate to SEV-Ops.

ben_runtime: quick commands I'm running:
```bash
# list nodes with GPU allocatable and free slices
kubectl get nodes -o json | jq '.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, gpuAlloc: .status.allocatable["nvidia.com/gpu"], labels: .metadata.labels}'
```

ben_runtime: Found 7 nodes with 2x1g free slices each that could be merged into 1x3g if we evict small-batch pods.

alice_oncall: eviction plan: mark pods `low-priority-batch` -> replace with ephemeral routes; scale them down 50% now. devon_support help identify tenants.

devon_support: doing that now. Sending list of batch job owners and ETA for pause: 2 min.

carla_mlinfra: I'm preparing a rollout to change node group MIG template for 3 nodes to use `3g.20gb` instead of `1g.6gb`. Will only touch a small subset (3 nodes) to reduce blast radius.

morgan_prodeng: Requesting temporary quota bump from cloud (case #CLOUD-19384) submitted. If we get +8 GPUs we can spin up 2 large nodes in 12-15min.

alice_oncall: meanwhile route config update to move enterprise customers A,B,C to dedicated pool in edge-router: `POST /v1/routing/override` with json body. Who can apply?

ben_runtime: I can apply the override. Pushing now.

ben_runtime: applied override for customers A,B,C. Monitoring: their requests now go to dedicated pool, success rate up to 99% for them.

eva_cs: notifying customers A,B,C: "We've routed your requests to dedicated capacity as temporary mitigation. No data migration required." Sent out.

devon_support: low-priority batches paused. freed ~4 small slices across 5 nodes. queue decreased ~12% in 3 minutes.

alice_oncall: good. next: manual drain plan to consolidate. ben, carla coordinate a safe drain/cordon sequence. we need to avoid double-scheduling.

ben_runtime: plan: for node in candidate_nodes: cordon; drain low-priority; if free slices coalesce into large capacity then uncordon and label as `mig-repacked=true`. Doing rolling 1 node at a time.

carla_mlinfra: note — avoid draining nodes running stateful inference (kv-cache pinned) => I added a nodeSelector to skip `kv-locked=true` nodes.

ben_runtime: started drain on node gpu-nodex-17. Logs: `evicted 12 pods, reclaimed 2x1g -> able to place 1x3g`

alice_oncall: monitoring metrics: `capacity_utilization` went from 72% -> 65% after first drain but large-inference placements increased. request queue down 18%.

morgan_prodeng: cloud responded to quota case: temporary +4 GPUs approved, ETA 16min to provision. good backup.

devon_support: customers reporting fewer errors; general error rate down 60% across affected tenants, still elevated for bulk inference.

alice_oncall: next steps for 30-min postmortem: root cause hypotheses list: mixed MIG profile churn after last deploy + autoscaler hitting global quota + insufficient fallback routing for burst. Action items: (1) enforce MIG profile rolling policy (2) add autoscaler backoff + partial placement logic (3) routing fallback for high-priority customers (4) run nightly fragmentation defrag job.

morgan_prodeng: assign to sprint and schedule a cross-team meeting. I'll own follow-up.

sre_shift_lead: handoff note for next oncall: we've performed manual node repacking, paused low-priority batches, temporarily rerouted top customers, requested quota bump. Current queue and errors trending down. Continue monitoring autoscaler logs and MIG fragmentation metrics. If queue > 1000 in next 30m escalate to SEV-Ops.

pagerduty: Incident ticket updated: SEV-High -> Mitigated. Keep channel open for 60m.

alice_oncall: thanks team. I'll build a short incident timeline and share in ~45min.

devon_support: prepping customer impact summary for postmortem. will include affected tenants list and error codes.

ben_runtime: leaving notes in infra runbook about manual repack steps and `kubectl` snippets used.

carla_mlinfra: will schedule a canary to deploy consistent MIG profile change next week.

eva_cs: customers A and B confirmed they are stable and satisfied with mitigation. C asked for SLA credit — forwarding to billing.

alice_oncall: closing updates. If anything spikes we'll reopen. :white_check_mark:
